title: MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.28586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. translated_title: MedCoast：面向测试时生物医学问答的推理轨迹语义抽象
translated_abstract: 生物医学问答通常需要在有限的推理预算下进行多步推理。虽然诸如思维树之类的测试时搜索方法可以提升推理性能，但直接在自由形式的语言上进行搜索计算成本高昂且高度冗余，因为许多推理轨迹包含以不同表面形式表达的语义等价的中间步骤。我们提出了MedCoast，这是一个离线到在线的推理框架，它将采样的思维链轨迹转换到一个紧凑空间中，以实现结构化的过程监督。在离线阶段，我们在共享前缀下递归地聚类语义相似的推理步骤，构建一个能够捕获重复出现的临床推理模式的抽象推理树。随后，我们从朝着正确解答的进展中推导出节点级别的监督信号，并训练一个轻量级的过程奖励模型（PRM）来评估部分推理状态。在推理阶段，该……
tldr: MedCoast通过将采样的思维链轨迹语义抽象为紧凑的推理树结构，并据此训练轻量级过程奖励模型进行过程监督，从而在有限推理预算下高效提升测试时生物医学问答的多步推理性能。
en_tdlr: MedCoast abstracts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact reasoning tree and trains a lightweight process reward model for structured process supervision, enabling efficient multi-step reasoning for test-time biomedical question answering under limited inference budgets.
